story.title: Sol the Centipede
paragraphs_en: Sol the centipede laid on the grass feeling sad on a sunny day.'The frogs are playing so happily. When will I have friends like them?' he sighed
The frogs have frogs,the snails have snails,the grasshoppers have grasshopers ,even the centipedes have other centipedes.But Sol did not have anyone.He felt too shy to talk to anyone!
'When will Sol ever make friends!'worried Sol's parents 'Oh you worry for nothing ! Sol will find his way!' said Sol's grandmother merrily

The frogs,the snails,the grass hoppers and the other centipedes often thought of Sol Some said 'I wonder if Sol would like being friends with us' some thought 'If Sol talks to us we will talk to Sol' Some did not notice Sol that much !
Sol cried and cried everyday 'I do not have any friends,everybody has friends,everybody needs to have friends,no one likes me maybe?'
On one such rainy day Sol was sitting alone.Suddenly along the pouring drops he saw a tiny flower standing alone ,smiling and shining.
The flower smiled warmly at Sol and Sol smiled back. Sol gathered some courage and asked the flower 'Dont you get bored by yourself?Standing alone?Where are your friends?'
'Hello there !I do get bored sometimes but mostly I don't. It is nice to stand in the rain like this.I like looking at the sun and the butterflies.Often I sing by myself.I like it a lot!'
'The Sun greets me,the Bee and I hangout,the grasshopper drops by too at times.It's fun.'
But it is also fun when I am by myself!'

Sol that day heard something that he had not heard before.He felt something he had not felt before.He saw something he had not seen before.He looked at the sun that stood by itself,the huge tree and the tiny butterfly.

Sol looked at himself.He looked at his tiny hundred legs that could take him anywhere.He moved around looking with wide eyes at the things that he had never seen.How refreshing the rain felt,how sweet was the smell of the soil,how swiftly he could move!
Slowly slowly Sol started doing things by himself.'It is fun to be by myself sometimes 'he thought.
There were days when Sol got bored and there were days when Sol just stood at one place happily looking at the flowers,the snail,the sky.
One day Sol was taking a stroll when he noticed a tiny frog looking at it with curious eyes.Sol looked at the frog and smiled warmly at it.The frog smiled back! What do you think happened next?
